name: plane-bebekpintar
description: MCP tools for the Plane Bebekpintar self-hosted instance across any workspace or project.

interface.shortDescription: Use Codex to read and manage Plane work across workspaces and projects.
interface.longDescription: Provides MCP tools for the self-hosted Plane Bebekpintar instance and can reduce repeated project-management chatter in chat by roughly 30-50% and repeated token spend by roughly 20-30% in issue-heavy workflows by fetching Plane data on demand instead of pasting it into context. Teams can target any workspace or project by changing workspace_slug and project_id, or by setting default environment variables.
defaultPrompt: List issues in the selected Plane project.
Move an issue to In Progress.
Create a module and attach an issue to it.
